author: fable-cursor
criterion: At viewpoint E the stones have visible thickness, edge bevels and joints with greenery, matching the plaza in the reference.
note: At E the plaza reads as 1-1.5 m pale blue-grey flat tiles separated by continuous orange soil grout; thickness shows on one slab edge at the right only, and the joints carry no greenery (bare orange bands with a hard edge). The reference's stones are 0.5-0.9 m, rounded, warm (#95815d lit / #777253 shade), visibly raised with a soft shadow into dark soil joints that carry grass sprouts and a moss halo. 555 stones and 555 shapes pass the gate; the criterion - visible thickness, edge bevels, joints with greenery matching the reference plaza - does not. Crops x 0.25-0.75 y 0.62-1.0 and x 0.55-0.95 y 0.66-1.0.
